workload: Actual program_brush example: 960x640 procedural paint, ordinary and scanline-filtered rounded panels; complete process including native shader/cache loading, resource creation, render, GPU readback and PNG output. Every measured image is compared with the baseline pixels.
percentile_method: nearest rank; p95 is the maximum of ten samples
shader_cache: warmed by two complete warmup pairs; this does not measure cold compilation
concurrency: no competing builds or GPU jobs
interpretation: Dead application-shader helpers, bindings and unused coordinate calculations are removed. No live shader math or renderer code changes. This actual application wall-time check includes PNG I/O and initialization; it neither isolates shader parsing nor measures GPU throughput. No runtime speedup is claimed.
